responsibility: Declares the selftest-only concrete subclasses of diagnostics::paths abstractions. It provides test_event, test_thread, and test_path for building synthetic diagnostic paths with locations, logical locations, stack depths, thread IDs, formatted descriptions, and optional control-flow links, serving as reusable fixtures for path-output, lazy-path, and sink tests.
same_name_distinction: Declares the reusable selftest fixture types test_event, test_thread, and test_path and their public path-building interface. Unlike selftest-paths.cc, it defines the types and inline accessors but not the event-formatting, storage, or path-construction implementations.
